messages:
Maya: Quick thread — we need to finalize speaker picks + rehearsal schedule for the April webinar. Goal: clear conversion narrative + 3 demos, 45 min total.
Jamal: prefer 3 speakers max. too many cooks. +1 on conversion focus.
Eva: Agreed. We should score candidates with a simple rubric: domain fit, demo readiness, timezone overlap, audience pull. 1-5 each.
Theo: Draft matrix attached (quick paste):
```
Name | role | domain | demo_ready | tz_overlap | audience_score | total
Aisha | infra eng | inference at scale | 5 | 4 | 4 | 17
Carlos | GTM PM | product story | 3 | 5 | 5 | 16
Priya | customer | reliability case | 4 | 3 | 3 | 13
```
Grace: Nice. can we add a column for backup role (e.g., demo fallback / shorter lightning)?
Maya: Yes — add "backup lane" boolean. We also need rehearsal windows that cover NA + EU. Proposed dry runs: Apr 8 10am PT and Apr 10 3pm BST.
Jamal: Can speakers do both? Aisha can only do morning PT. Carlos prefers afternoons BST. Priya flexible.
Eva: Suggest final speaker set: Aisha (lead demo), Carlos (product narrative + Q), Priya (customer perspective + backup demo).
Maya: OK tentative. Next: rehearsal checklist. Short script + prompts, demo creds, failover steps, slide deck + two-run plan. Keep rehearsals under 60m.
Theo: Rehearsal run-of-show (short):
```
00:00 - 00:05 host intro
00:05 - 00:20 Aisha demo (live)
00:20 - 00:30 Carlos product narrative + microbenchmarks
00:30 - 00:40 Priya customer story + Q
00:40 - 00:45 live Q&A
00:45 - 00:50 closing CTA + lead routing note
```
Grace: For lead routing: tag inbound with utm_campaign=ai-serving-webinar, utm_content=speaker-demo-Aisha. SDR queue: webinar-inbound. Prioritization rule: attended + asked question -> MQL.
Maya: Target conversion: 8-12% attended->trial signups. Is that aggressive?
Jamal: Reasonable if we push a post-webinar offer and follow-up sequence. Need a dedicated landing page + 48h trial code.
Eva: Messaging variants for A/B test in signup flow: (A) "See token-level savings" vs (B) "See live demo of <model> performance".
Theo: Ops-bot: automated reminder + calendar invites will go out 72h and 1h prior. ops-bot: noted. :robot_face:
ops-bot: Reminder templates queued for 72h/24h/1h. RSVP counts will post to #marketing-dash every 6h.
Grace: We also need a fallback demo (recorded) in case live Aisha demo fails — Priya can run a recorded clip and do commentary. Priya: ok for recorded fallback.
Maya: Action items: 1) Jamal finalize speaker outreach today. 2) Theo build rehearsal doc + matrix (add backup lane). 3) Grace wire lead routing + landing page copy. 4) Eva A/B signup copy. 5) Ops-bot schedule invites.
Jamal: I'll ping Aisha/Carlos/Priya now.
Eva: + please capture speakers' tech constraints (no VPN, browser, gpu access) in rehearsal doc.
Maya: Cool. If we lock speakers by EOD tomorrow we can run first dry-run next week. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
